source: Derived from .claude/skills/brand-design-systems/brands/linear.app.md (near-black #010102 canvas, light-gray #f7f8f8 ink, signature lavender-blue accent, charcoal hairline panels, measured negative-tracking display sans).

token_notes.canvas: #010102 is Linear's canvas, the deepest dark surface in the brand library. Reads distinct from the recent violet-midnight (sentry) and steel (subway-chrome) dark runs.
token_notes.accent: #828fff is Linear's lighter lavender (their primary-hover tone). The signature #5e6ad2 lands at 4.44:1 on canvas, just under the 4.5 mono floor, so the brighter lavender is used at 7.27:1 while staying an authentic Linear brand color.
token_notes.fonts: Linear's custom sans is unavailable. Inter is the closest shipped geometric-sans match for Linear's neutral, negative-tracked display voice.
